blocks.text: CEBU CITY — The Cebu provincial government has allowed the shipment of live hogs intended for lechon production, subject to protocols and biosecurity requirements. Gov. Pamela Baricuatro issued Executive Order (EO) No. 55 on Oct. 26, allowing the entry of pigs intended for lechon production. The policy allows lechon producers to source live hogs from outside Cebu, subject to government clearance, while retaining restrictions intended to prevent the spread of African swine fever (ASF). The EO emphasized that pigs must be intended for immediate slaughter at accredited facilities in Cebu, provided that shipments comply with veterinary quarantine and animal health regulations. […]...
